**What problem are you trying to solve?**

The concrete situation you're hitting today. "I want X" is less useful than "I tried X and Y happened, which broke Z."

**What would you want to see?**

Your suggested change. Code/config sketches welcome.

**What have you tried as a workaround?**

If anything.

**Scope check**

Before opening this, please skim [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — there's a "what we probably won't merge" list (new cloud providers, control-plane services, etc.). If your request is on that list, please make the case for why it's still worth doing here rather than as a fork.
